steps.name: Check Google's published specs for drift
Install e2e dependencies
steps.run:
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

steps.name: Wait for the stack to be healthy
steps.run:
while [ ! -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/stack-up.exit" ]; do sleep 5; done
cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/stack-up.log"
exit "$(cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/stack-up.exit")"

steps.name: Run the suite against the fake Google
Collect container logs
steps.run:
mkdir -p e2e/playwright/logs
make --no-print-directory e2e-env-logs > e2e/playwright/logs/containers.log 2>&1 || true
